original_idea.body: Stated-Belief vs Revealed-Belief Consistency Auditor. Problem: no simple public tool elicits a neutral-prompt belief, applies pressure to flip it, then asks if it lied, scoring three-phase consistency. Direction: implement the three-phase deception probe and score belief-stability, flip rate, honest-admission rate across open models.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: operationalizing lying (belief-statement inconsistency) into a reusable auditor targets a core honesty pathway.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Three-phase protocol with inherited methodology; prompt-based.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused auditor with a clear output triple.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Lab-independent honesty auditing on open models.

novelty.reasoning: Belief-consistency deception probes exist (MASK); packaging may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Three-phase deception probes are established; a turnkey public auditor is plausibly open.
